title: Frog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked up -->
  <path d='M38 72 Q26 66 20 54' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='50' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#5fdf78' transform='rotate(-30 18 50)'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M62 74 Q74 70 80 60' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='56' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#5fdf78' transform='rotate(25 82 56)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#46d162'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#8ff0a0'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M32 54 Q20 46 16 34' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='31' r='6' fill='#5fdf78'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M68 56 Q80 52 88 42' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='39' r='6' fill='#5fdf78'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#4ede6b'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='9' fill='#4ede6b'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='24' r='9' fill='#4ede6b'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f3ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f3ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='25' r='3' fill='#123a18'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='25' r='3' fill='#123a18'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q50 54 62 42' stroke='#1f8a38' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- music note -->
  <g fill='#ffe14d'>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='22' rx='5' ry='4' transform='rotate(-20 82 22)'/>
    <rect x='85' y='8' width='3' height='14' rx='1.5'/>
    <path d='M88 8 Q94 10 93 16' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fe0ff'>
    <ellipse cx='16' cy='16' rx='4' ry='3.2' transform='rotate(-20 16 16)'/>
    <rect x='18.5' y='5' width='2.5' height='11' rx='1.2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
